cancellation_extra_gc.interpretation: Large single-collection residuals are consistent with finalizer-delayed reclamation. After three collections there is no operation-count-proportional heap growth between 100 and 1000. Totals do not identify every byte or exclude bounded retained objects.

notes: Named/existing-context inline cost is one 68-byte Result userdata per wait plus one lazily created cell per Task.
Captured immutable scalar and bound-receiver cases add one closure; mutable capture-cell cost is outside these fixtures.
Cancellable FS fixture includes an extra Result constructed for common checks.
The mixed case is four waits per loop iteration.
Legacy typed six closures consist of an outer callable adapter, two resolve/reject adapters, and three old_void_start callbacks.

identity.native_policy: default -O3 -flto=auto -ffat-lto-objects; patched bundled libuv; system OpenSSL

limitations: Module loading occurs before the hook. Whole-lifecycle control includes Runtime/Task and fixed harness overhead.
Lua live/peak totals are whole-process heap bookkeeping, not object reachability proof.
Native coroutine stacks and native allocators are outside the Lua ledger. Process max RSS is a separate whole-process measure.

Forced GC clocks in the general allocation matrices were observed during instrumented, non-quiescent runs; the separate quiet_timing section reports its own uninstrumented forced-GC clocks. Neither records automatic GC cycle counts.
Exact context-retention and TCP resource-retention tests are separate evidence.

method.cancellation_grid: 2 lanes x 2 hosts x 3 cases x 3 counts = 36
method.collection_control: Task/status roots dropped; 2 explicit full collections followed by probe.finish third full collection; scalar samples before result-table allocation
method.general_allocation_grid: 18 cases x 3 counts x 2 hosts + 2 whole controls + 6 GC-stopped cases x 2 hosts = 122
method.heap_peak_and_live: body peak/live minus initial live heap
method.historical_environment: Original allocation runner records selected policy and clears Lua/Titan/loader/compiler overrides, but inherits other ambient entries. It is not a hermetic baseline.
method.postgc_minus_zero: postgc actual live heap minus same host/case/lane count-zero run
method.source_paths: Both authoritative general matrices use the preserved original Lua chunk filenames and ./bench.titan generated source path. Separate cancellation control uses common current paths across its two lanes.
method.timing: The quiet_timing section reports the completed, separately executed uninstrumented paired comparison. Clocks in the historical general allocation matrices remain instrumented observations and are not final timing evidence.

host.model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M
host.scope: Build/test/transfer/archive/hash/PE work in coordinated local and VM lanes was idle. VMs remained running but guest workloads were explicitly quiescent; desktop/background OS activity was not disabled. No CPU pinning or governor tuning was applied.

policy.body_allocator_hook: disabled; process timing plus explicit forced-post-GC clocks only
policy.cpu_scope: process CPU clock includes its threads and excludes child process CPU; it can exceed wall time for native thread-pool work
policy.forced_gc_scope: Body timing runs only: one explicit full collection after body and teardown, with roots dropped; not automatic cycle count or total GC cost.
policy.latency_elapsed_clock_scope: Starts before Runtime/Task launch and stops at entry to probe.finish after loop and status check; excludes sorting/result construction; no forced GC.
policy.latency_interval_scope: time between successive per-task sample calls after yield and raw 1 ms timer interarrival; timer interval is not deadline lateness
policy.latency_quantiles: each run uses sorted sample indices floor((n-1)*p/100), p=50,95,99; across-run summaries are median/min/max of those per-run quantiles, not pooled samples
policy.latency_sampler: separate native preallocated arrays, monotonic clock sampled on each task resumption and 1 ms timer callback; no allocator hook
policy.repeat_order: AB on even zero-based repeat; BA on odd; warmup and pilot pairs retained separately

status: allocation, retention, and quiet paired timing/latency evidence complete

tcp_retention.comparison_scope: Lua allocator retention; not native malloc or timing comparison

units.functions: new Lua function objects reported by allocator type tag
units.gc_clocks: seconds, instrumented non-quiescent collection-work observations; not speedup evidence
units.requested_bytes: successful Lua allocator request bytes, including resizes; not retained bytes
units.userdata: new Lua userdata allocations reported by allocator type tag
